# vastdata_support_bundles_queue (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key` (String) S3 Bucket access key
- `aggregated` (Boolean) Aggregate harvests into final bundle (deprecated)
- `astron_args` (String)
- `bucket_name` (String) S3 Bucket for upload
- `bucket_subdir` (String) Sub-directory in support bucket
- `bundle_file` (String)
- `bundle_size` (Number) Bundle size in bytes
- `bundle_url` (String) URL to access/download support bundle file
- `callhome` (Boolean)
- `cluster` (String) Parent Cluster
- `cluster_id` (Number)
- `cnodes_only` (Boolean)
- `core` (Boolean)
- `create_datetime` (String)
- `created` (String) Bundle creation time
- `delete_after_send` (Boolean) Delete the bundle immediately after successfully uploading
- `dnodes_only` (Boolean)
- `end_time` (String) End time of logs in UTC+3
- `guid` (String)
- `hubble_args` (String)
- `level` (String) Bundle level e.g. small, medium, large
- `luna_args` (String)
- `management` (Boolean)
- `max_size` (Number) Trace files bundle size limit in GB for each node
- `mem_traces` (Boolean)
- `metrics` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `obfuscated` (Boolean) True if the bundle is obfuscated. If obfuscated, all bundled objects are converted to text and obfuscated. Any data that cannot be converted to text is not included in the bundle. The following types of information are replaced with a non-reversible hash: file and directory names, IP addresses, host names, user names, passwords, MAC addresses.
- `on_nfs` (Boolean) True if the bundle is stored on NFS
- `performance` (Boolean)
- `platform` (Boolean)
- `position_in_queue` (Number) Position of the support bundle in the queue
- `prefix` (String) Identifying label included in the bundle file name as a prefix
- `preset` (String) Type of predefined preset bundle
- `secret_key` (String) S3 Bucket secret key
- `send_now` (Boolean) Upload support bundle after creation
- `start_time` (String) Start time of logs in UTC+3
- `state` (String) State of the bundle
- `text` (Boolean) True if only textual logs are included in the bundle
- `traces` (Boolean)
- `upload_via_vms` (Boolean)
- `url` (String)
- `volume_size` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `cnode_ids` (Set of Number) Array of IDs of specific CNodes from which logs are collected. If not specified, logs are collected from all CNodes.
- `cnode_ids_array` (Set of Number) Resolved CNode IDs included in the bundle harvest
- `dnode_ids` (Set of Number) Array of IDs of specific DNodes from which logs are collected. If not specified, logs are collected from all DNodes.
- `dnode_ids_array` (Set of Number) Resolved DNode IDs included in the bundle harvest
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
